newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Aluminium Industries targets 18,000T output a year.
newsitem.headline: Aluminium Industries targets 18,000T output a year.

text.p: Malaysia's Aluminium Industries Bhd plans to increase output by 80 percent to 18,000 tonnes annually from this year, following a 45 million ringgit ($18 million) capacity expansion, officials said.
The company is one of the two main producers of aluminium rolled products in Malaysia.
A new cold rolling mill, casting line, hydraulic tension leveller and assorted equipment would be installed by November to improve the company's present capacity of 10,000 tonnes, the officials said.
